post.title: A new car costs about $64,315 over 5 years, per AAA
post.ig:
Five years of a new car: about $64,315, per AAA's 2026 Your Driving Costs study.

That's $12,863 a year x 5, versus a $39,376 average sticker price (MSRP) in the study.
The biggest slice is depreciation: $4,422 a year, or $22,110 over five years. Then fuel $2,595, insurance $2,098, finance charges $1,184.
Edmunds put average lifetime interest on a new-car loan at $9,938 in Q3 2026 (7.0% APR). Kelley Blue Book's average transaction price was $50,089 in August 2026.

Sources: AAA Your Driving Costs 2026 (Sept 2026; 15,000 miles a year, 5 years); Edmunds Q3 2026; Kelley Blue Book, Sept 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
